description: This file defines a logging system with classes for managing log files, logging messages with severity levels, and flushing log data. It includes class declarations for LogFile, Logger, and Flusher, along with an enum for severity levels.

classes.name: LogFile
classes.description: Singleton class managing log file operations such as writing, opening, and closing the log file.

classes.name: Flusher
classes.description: Helper class for buffering and flushing log messages with a specific severity and component name.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Main logging class used to create log entries associated with a specific component, supporting severity levels.

methods.name: LogFile::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LogFile.

methods.name: LogFile::write
methods.description: Writes a line to the log file.

methods.name: Flusher::operator<<
methods.description: Appends text to the internal stringstream buffer.

methods.name: Logger::operator<<
methods.description: Creates a Flusher object for logging with a specified severity.
